objective: Select a 7- or 10-region fixed front-camera feature representation for direct whole-frame lane-IoU regression.
perception: TwinLiteNet+ Medium v6 fixed; reuse paired RGB and saved four-channel f0 head maps.
inner_cv: 3 folds of original six training zones; fit all preprocessing on inner training only.
model_selection: tune equal 12 settings per RF/GP and ROI/feature arm on training group-CV; choose the feature arm on original development, separately for each model and ROI.
label: whole-frame white+yellow lane IoU; actual IoU < .7 is low; undefined IoU stays in review budget.
same_inputs: identical raw RGB, f0 maps, targets, split membership, inner CV folds, random seeds and review windows for paired ROI comparisons.
review: global lowest-score 10 percent and matched 64-frame windows, exact sample-ID tie rule. Report normal denominator and cohort low prevalence.
decision: prefer 7 if paired diagnostics show MAE loss <= .003 and Recall@10% loss <= .02 against 10 for the selected practical model, with no repeated missed failure category; otherwise select 10. Report cohort and grouped paired-bootstrap sensitivity instead of counting adjacent frames as independent.
integrity: verify source RGB hashes, cached map IDs/checkpoint, cached target IDs; check duplicate pixels and spatial/group overlap.
scope_note: All initial diagnostic images have been examined in previous research with other estimators. This is a paired ROI representation comparison on existing data. Independent future generalization requires a new held road.

fresh.selection: Map geometry only; new link per site, at least 20m from all 14331 existing analysis frames, at least 25m between sites. Alternate straight and curved when available.
fresh.scope: Prospective paired camera data scored once by already frozen models. No feature or hyperparameter refit from this collection.

fresh_marked.selection: Supplementary geometry-and-map-metadata selection after reviewing sparse marking in the first cohort: both left/right lane_mark references must be nonempty. New link per site, >=20m from all existing archived and first prospective frames, >=25m between sites. Alternating straight/curved where available. No camera frame, target, or prediction used to rank these locations.
fresh_marked.scope: Second prospective paired cohort for marked-road coverage, prompted by data-quality audit. Score once by the same already frozen models; no feature or hyperparameter refit. Keep the first cohort fully reported, including sparse lane scenes.

interpretation: The original margin statement did not prescribe an aggregation level or formal noninferiority test. Report both macro and frame-weighted summaries, cohort regressions and spatial-group intervals. The selected ROI is a practical baseline decision, not a universal dominance claim.
